title: Newmark Arranges $65 Million Sale of Class A Greenwich Medical Center in Greenwich, Connecticut
summary: Newmark announces the Company has arranged the ~$65 million sale of Greenwich Medical Center at Holly Hill, a 106,092-square-foot Class A outpatient…
body_markdown:
**September 2, 2026 9:00 AM**
Newmark announces the Company has arranged the ~$65 million sale of Greenwich Medical Center at Holly Hill, a 106,092-square-foot Class A outpatient medical campus located at 75 Holly Hill Lane in Greenwich, Connecticut. Benedict Realty Group sold the property to Healthcare Realty


Co-Heads of U.S.[Medical Office Capital Markets](https://www.nmrk.com/services/capital-markets/healthcare-capital-markets)[Ben Appel](https://www.nmrk.com/people/ben-appel) ,[Justin Shepherd](https://www.nmrk.com/people/justin-shepherd) and[Jay Miele](https://www.nmrk.com/people/jay-miele) , U.S Head of Medical Office Debt,[John Nero](https://www.nmrk.com/people/john-p-nero) , alongside Senior Managing Director[Michael Greeley](https://www.nmrk.com/people/michael-greeley) and Associate Directors[Ron Ott](https://www.nmrk.com/people/ron-ott) ,[Conor Hilton](https://www.nmrk.com/people/conor-hilton) , and[Drew Martin](https://www.nmrk.com/people/drew-martin) , represented the seller in the transaction.


Renovated in 2016, Greenwich Medical Center at Holly Hill is a premier outpatient medical campus that is 97% leased to a diversified roster of leading healthcare providers. The property is anchored by Yale New Haven Health and Stamford Health and serves as a key outpatient destination within Fairfield County’s established healthcare corridor.


Located along West Putnam Avenue (U.S. Route 1), Greenwich’s “Doctor’s Row,” the asset benefits from exceptional regional connectivity, affluent demographics and a highly supply-constrained medical office market. The property’s proximity to Greenwich Hospital and other major healthcare facilities further reinforces its position as one of the region’s premier outpatient medical assets.


“Greenwich has a cache that outshines most U.S markets, attracting both private and institutional interest from domestic and abroad. Further, this is a market that features high, and growing, rents and very tight occupancies across bothe the medical and corporate office market, resulting in very strong long-term performance,” said Appel. “The confluence of these characteristics resulted in a very deep buyer pool.”
